messages.subject: Many many warning messages when bootstrapping
parts:
When I bootstrap and get a warning message, I get it for every itereation of the bootstrap, I have tried setting warn = FALSE but alas I continue to get 1,000 warnings.

fit <- sem(model, data=myData, se = "bootstrap", missing = "fiml" warn = FALSE)
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

If this is just a "feature" of the package, then perhaps you could point me to where I could make a feature request. However, if there is a way to switch it off, or preferably just display unique warning messages, that would be great.
